# Making *complex data*
legible to anyone in the room.

::: {.hero-sub}
I'm Max Avramis — a recent Master of Public Policy graduate from UC San Diego's School of Global Policy and Strategy, specializing in American and Comparative Business Regulation and Program Design and Evaluation. I combine GIS, machine learning, and policy analysis to turn messy, multi-source data into decisions that actually land. Open to full-time roles and consulting engagements.
